info.description: Versioned commerce and customer-management API. Adzbyte App is the system of record; adzbyte-next consumes approved storefront contracts.

post.summary: Mint a one-use 60-second View Cart transfer
post.description: Requires cart:handoff and independent cart proof. The fixed destination is the app cart landing page. Mint retries recover the same active unused capability; expired/consumed/pruned/rotated issuance requires a new UUID and never revives the old token. No customer is attached and cart items do not expire.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Same durable per-cart UUID only for an identical command. Never reuse an issuance UUID for another operation.

201.description: Private transfer URL and expiry; do not log or cache.

409.description: Previous issuance expired, was consumed/pruned or its binding changed; request a new operation.

422.description: Invalid body, proof or UUID reuse.

post.summary: Atomically consume a transfer into the app guest session
post.description: Uses web/session/CSRF middleware. The nonce-CSP landing page clears the token fragment, then posts same-origin JSON. Success rotates the app session/CSRF and grants only this cart. Replay/expiry/revoked issuer/changed cart authority/key rotation fail closed. On a lost consume response, a fresh View Cart link can recover the unchanged persistent cart. No supplied owner/reference/hash/redirect is accepted.

sanctumBearer.description: Revocable Laravel Sanctum personal access token.

storefrontBearer.description: Actual revocable Sanctum personal token for a verified service identity with no roles/direct permissions. Only cart:create, cart:read, cart:write and cart:handoff abilities are permitted; wildcard/excessive scopes and session fallback are forbidden. Each operation requires its named ability.

cartProof.name: X-Cart-Proof
cartProof.description: Server-generated 32-byte guest proof encoded as 64 lowercase hex characters. Required independently of the service token. Never place this proof in URLs or browser JavaScript.

appCartSession.name: adzbyte-session
appCartSession.description: App guest session opened by a valid consumed cart transfer. Cookie name follows SESSION_COOKIE (template default APP_NAME=Adzbyte gives adzbyte-session). This session alone is not customer authentication or ownership attachment.

appCsrf.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
appCsrf.description: CSRF value from the app landing page meta tag/current app session. Required for app-session mutations; a Bearer token/cart proof is not a substitute.
